_about: Copy to ~/LuminaEvidence/masklab/prompts.json. One entry per clip, keyed by the clip's file name without extension. start: the frame the object is selected on (0 = the clip's first frame). box: [x, y, w, h] or point: [x, y], normalized 0..1 with the origin at the top left of the frame. frames (optional): stop after this many frames. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
